2. Man attempted to receive duplicate ballot around 11:40 AM
3. He changed clothes and skipped identity verification to get in line for second ballot
4. He self-reported before receiving the second ballot to protest poor management
5. The polling station had separate lines for identity check and ballot receipt, creating loophole
6. Other citizens also protested, police called, controversy over management gaps
